name: Set Up Door for Painting
intent: Drop a small floor cloth at the door, install spray protection (overspray cover for surrounding wall) for spray methods, remove hardware (spray) or mask hardware in place (brush). Per-door rates because door work is per-opening, not per-room.
doctrine: Per-door rates assume one knob, two hinges, and a strike plate per opening. Hardware removal (3 EA/hr = 20 minutes per door) is slower than masking in place (4 EA/hr = 15 minutes) but produces a cleaner finish for spray work. Brush work doesn't require hardware removal because the painter cuts around hardware with a brush. Spray protection (6 EA/hr) covers the wall opening surround to catch overspray.
